      Why it's different

      Fresh bread.
      Real ribeye.
      Big sandwich.

      The menu says it plainly: 100% ribeye. One regular went digging and found out the bread is made daily by a guy from Italy. The OTB comes with the house OTB Ranch and OTB Tang on top. And when you want it extra messy, there's the Philly Melt on Texas toast or a box of OTB Fries.
